claims.statement: A report about a just-enacted continuation necessarily uses a later report route, but this does not identify its target with explicit recollection or recognition of prior practice; event retention and practice memory have different representational objects.
claims.domain: One fixed bearer, enacted event and later response under the declared question contract.
all_of: event and response times are distinct
the earlier event is explicitly indexed
no truth calibration is inferred from the distinction
claims.counterexample_boundary: A particular report mechanism may still compute its answer solely from effort or practice memory; the conceptual distinction does not exclude that empirical possibility.
claims.thought_role: Copy/swap/memory separates event trace, autobiography and report.

claims.statement: Across all eight stipulated content×effort×practice-memory vignettes, the declared target, ease-substitution, practice-memory and target-or-memory policies have distinct signatures; target differs from each pure substitution in four cells.
claims.domain: Deterministic comprehension policies over a stipulated three-bit vignette space.
all_of: intended-content bit is not treated as phenomenal truth
claims.counterexample_boundary: Does not establish human realizability, stochastic-policy identifiability, signed reliability or H_way measurement.
claims.thought_role: Abacus/calculator exposes equal correct responses generated by different policies.

claims.statement: The bounded instrument has three one-sided vetoes—effort substitution, practice-memory substitution and event drift. Any failure blocks use of this item for the selected continuation target; passing all three does not certify target identity or truth.
claims.domain: Predeclared continuation question, comprehension screen and counterbalanced event-indexed blocks.
claims.counterexample_boundary: An unmodelled response policy can survive; perturbations can change the target experience as well as the nuisance variable.
claims.thought_role: Human-realized agent prevents group or report roles from being assigned to an unbound bearer.

claims.statement: A4I refines the measurement axis of A4H without supplying actual B_relation use or distinguishing B_relation from B_fit; organizational and target/report evidence remain independent axes.
claims.domain: A4H B_summary/B_relation/B_fit comparison under A3X–A4A limits.
claims.counterexample_boundary: A valid event question can still measure a B_fit-dependent target or fail to track any phenomenal distinction.
claims.thought_role: Formation distinguishes acquired relation from its later report.
